FEAT-1-STORY-104.title: Implement vector-based provider search
FEAT-1-STORY-104.description: Develop core search logic using MongoDB Atlas vector search with embeddings to retrieve relevant providers based on semantic query matching.

FEAT-1-STORY-105.title: Implement taxonomy fallback using NUCC codes
FEAT-1-STORY-105.description: Add fallback search path using NUCC taxonomy codes when vector search yields insufficient or empty results, ensuring consistent provider retrieval.

FEAT-1-STORY-106.title: Apply location filtering with FIPS and city/state logic
FEAT-1-STORY-106.description: Implement multi-stage location filtering including FIPS-to-county mapping, state and city constraints, and distance-aware narrowing of provider results.
